title: Investor letter: TCI, one of the world's biggest hedge funds, cut almost all of its $8B stake in Microsoft, citing AI-related risks to Office and Azure (Costas Mourselas/Financial Times)
summary: Costas Mourselas / Financial Times: Investor letter: TCI, one of the world's biggest hedge funds, cut almost all of its $8B stake in Microsoft, citing AI-related risks to Office and Azure — TCI has cut its position in tech giant from 10% to 1% — Sir Christopher Hohn's hedge fund TCI has dumped almost all of its $8bn stake …
contentText:
Costas Mourselas / Financial Times :

Investor letter: TCI, one of the world's biggest hedge funds, cut almost all of its $8B stake in Microsoft, citing AI-related risks to Office and Azure   —  TCI has cut its position in tech giant from 10% to 1%  —  Sir Christopher Hohn's hedge fund TCI has dumped almost all of its $8bn stake …
